# Plan: `grill` mode for poe

## Objective
New mode `/poe:poe grill <task | plan-path>`: interview user in rounds (Matt Pocock's grill-with-docs method) until design tree resolved, then write the same `plan.md` plan mode writes. Also maintains `GLOSSARY.md` + ADRs inline. `plan` mode unchanged (one-shot).

Upstream (MIT, © 2026 Matt Pocock, github.com/mattpocock/skills), researched in `poe/trash/poe-grill-with-docs/plan.md`:
- `grill-with-docs` = shim over `grilling` + `domain-modeling`.
- `grilling`: design tree; each round asks whole **frontier** (questions whose prerequisites are settled); numbered, recommended answer per question, "yes" accepts all; wait. Facts = agent looks up; decisions = user. Done when frontier empty + user confirms.
- `domain-modeling`: challenge/sharpen terms, edge-case scenarios, code cross-check; write `GLOSSARY.md` the moment a term resolves; ADR only if hard to reverse **and** surprising **and** real trade-off.
- Upstream gap: non-ADR decisions live only in conversation. Fix: every decision → `plan.md` `## Decisions` each round.

## Grill vs plan (why a separate mode)
| | `plan` | `grill` |
|---|---|---|
| Turns | 1 + review edits | many rounds, then plan |
| Who decides | agent assumes, user corrects after | user decides up front, agent recommends |
| Best for | clear, small, well-specified tasks | fuzzy scope, new domain, real trade-offs, high cost of rework |
| Output | `plan.md` | `plan.md` + `## Decisions` + `GLOSSARY.md` / ADRs |
| Cost | cheap, fast | slower, more user attention, more parent context |
| Failure mode | hidden assumptions → rework in execute | interview fatigue, over-asking trivia, bikeshedding |

- Separate mode > always-on: user picks rigor per task; `plan` stays fast; no flag needed.
- Separate mode cost: two plan paths to keep consistent → grill reuses plan mode steps 2–5 verbatim by reference, not a copy.
- Extra win: `grill <plan-path>` stress-tests a plan made by `plan`, and resumes an interrupted grill after `/clear` (Decisions on disk).

## Decisions
- Separate `grill` mode; `plan` untouched. (user request)
- Method adapted inline as bundled `skills/poe/GRILLING.md`; no dependency on upstream skills. (carried from trashed plan)
- `GLOSSARY.md` + `docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md` at cwd root (upstream layout), created lazily, persist across tasks. (carried from trashed plan)
- Rounds as plain text, not AskUserQuestion (4-question cap; recommendations need prose). (carried)

## Scope
In:
- **New `skills/poe/GRILLING.md`**: credit + link + MIT notice. Condensed:
  - Rounds: frontier, numbered `Q1..Qn`, recommended answer each, "yes" = accept all; wait.
  - Facts via codebase/read-only subagents, never asked.
  - Recommendations obey SKILL.md "do not overengineer".
  - Glossary rules + format (term, 1–2 sentence def, `_Avoid_:` synonyms; project terms only; no implementation detail).
  - ADR 3 gates + format; number = highest existing + 1.
  - Stop asking when frontier empty; skip trivia; small task may need 1 round.
- **`skills/poe/SKILL.md`**:
  - `argument-hint` + Operating modes: add `grill <task | plan-path>`; may write `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/adr/` at cwd root; no implementation files.
  - Files section: note `GLOSSARY.md` / `docs/adr/` live outside `poe/`.
  - New "Grill mode" section:
    1. Plan mode step 1 + read existing `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/adr/`; read `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/GRILLING.md` (explicit step; guards upstream not-loaded bug).
    2. Arg is existing `plan.md` → load it + its `## Decisions`, grill only open/risky points. Else new slug; create `plan.md` holding only `## Decisions`.
    3. Each round: ask, stop. After answers: append to `## Decisions`, write glossary/ADR changes immediately.
    4. Frontier empty → ask user to confirm shared understanding.
    5. On confirm → write full plan per Plan mode steps 2–4, keep `## Decisions`, link ADRs. Then Plan mode step 5 (reply + `Next:` split block).
    6. Copy logs at end only.
  - Split step 4: if `GLOSSARY.md` / relevant ADRs exist, list in unit inputs.
- **`README.md`**: usage line + bullet for grill; when to use grill vs plan (1–2 lines); Files mentions `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/adr/`; References credits mattpocock/skills.

Out:
- Changes to `plan` mode behavior.
- `phase-worker.md`, `poe_report.py`, tests code.
- Upstream to-spec / wayfinder / other skills.
- Flags/config; glossary in report.html.

## Assumptions
- Builds on uncommitted `less_verboosity` edits (Output style, terse replies). Keep them.
- Round questions terse per Output style, but recommendation per question always kept.
- cwd = docs location even if not repo root (matches poe's cwd rule).

## Acceptance criteria
- `GRILLING.md` exists, credits upstream w/ MIT notice, covers every Scope item.
- SKILL.md: `grill` in argument-hint + modes; Grill mode section has steps 1–6; reuses Plan mode steps by reference; `plan` section diff = none.
- Split step 4 mentions glossary/ADR inputs.
- `claude plugin validate .` passes.
- `python3 -m unittest discover tests` passes (sanity).
- Manual run shows: numbered rounds w/ recommendations; no full plan before confirm; facts looked up not asked; `## Decisions` grows per round; `GLOSSARY.md` written mid-session; ADRs only when gated (zero ok); reply ends with `Next:` block; `grill <existing plan.md>` resumes without re-asking settled decisions.

## Risks
- Interview fatigue / trivia questions. Mitigation: recommendations, "yes" accepts round, "skip trivia" rule.
- Model writes docs only at end (upstream bug). Mitigation: explicit per-round write step; check in manual run.
- Writes outside `poe/` into user repo. Mitigation: lazy creation; README note.
- Parent context grows over many rounds. Mitigation: Decisions on disk → `/clear` + `grill <plan-path>` resumes.
- Drift between plan and grill final-plan rules. Mitigation: reference, don't copy.
- License: condensed copy credited + MIT notice.

## Validation
- `claude plugin validate .`
- `python3 -m unittest discover tests`
- Manual: scratch git repo w/ few files; `claude --plugin-dir <this repo>`; `/poe:poe grill <fuzzy toy task, e.g. "add archiving for old notes">`; answer 2–3 rounds (mix "yes" + overrides); after each: `git status`, `cat GLOSSARY.md`, `cat poe/<slug>/plan.md`. Then `/clear`, `/poe:poe grill poe/<slug>/plan.md` → no settled question re-asked. Then `/poe:poe plan <same task>` → still one-shot, no grilling. Then `split` → briefs list `GLOSSARY.md`.

9. Write the same report to `summary.md` (what passed, what remains uncertain, blockers, and file locations), overwriting any earlier one; `status.md` stays the source of truth for state. Then copy the logs (see Logs) and build the report (see Report).

At the end of every mode (`plan`, `split`, `execute`, `resume`, `report`), and whenever execution stops for user input, copy this session's transcripts into the task directory:

```sh
dest="poe/<short-task-slug>/logs/66cf141d-b20e-4312-a7bd-37c7d4d8209a"
src=$(find "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/projects" -name "66cf141d-b20e-4312-a7bd-37c7d4d8209a.jsonl" | head -1)
mkdir -p "$dest"
cp "$src" "$dest/"
[ -d "${src%.jsonl}/subagents" ] && cp -R "${src%.jsonl}/subagents" "$dest/"
```

- Re-running it overwrites the earlier copy with the current, longer transcript, so repeating it is safe.
- The copy is a snapshot: anything after it (such as the final reply of the turn) is missing until the next copy.
- If the transcript cannot be found (`src` is empty or `cp` fails), say so in the reply and carry on. A missing log never blocks the task.

## Report

At the end of `execute` and `resume` (after `summary.md` and the log copy), and in `report` mode, build `report.html` from the task directory:

```sh
python3 "/Users/sbandyopadhyay/projects/SCRIPTS/custom_claude_plugins/poe/skills/poe/scripts/poe_report.py" poe/<short-task-slug>
```

- The script writes `poe/<short-task-slug>/report.html` and prints its path. Re-running it replaces the earlier report.
- If it fails (for example, `python3` is missing or the command is refused), say so in the reply and carry on. A missing report never blocks the task.

## Progress notes

Each worker keeps one file, `progress/NN-unit.md`, and updates it throughout its run. `resume` and any follow-on worker rely on it, so it must make sense to an agent that has seen nothing else.

```
# Unit ID: status (in progress | done | partial | blocked)
## Done so far
## Files changed or produced
## Tests run and observed results
## Decisions and assumptions
## Next step / remaining work
```

When a unit is handed to a second worker, that worker reads the existing notes and continues in the same file.

## Context policy: about 100k tokens per agent

- 100k is a **soft target**, not a hard limit. Never claim to know exact token usage unless a tool reports it; otherwise judge by how much has been read and produced.
- Hand over at a natural boundary, not at a number. When a worker nears the target, it finishes the step it is in the middle of (an edit in flight, a test run, a debugging thread that is about to resolve), then brings its progress notes up to date and returns `partial`. Going moderately over the target to finish a coherent step is correct; stopping mid-edit to respect the number is not.
- The orchestrator then starts a **fresh non-fork worker** for the remainder, pointed at the progress notes. Do not keep resuming a bloated agent.
- Prefer this file-based handover to automatic compaction. Automatic compaction is a backstop: it can fire in the middle of a step and loses detail, which is why the notes are kept current throughout.
- Keep the parent lean: orchestration and short summaries only; delegate large searches, code reading, and log interpretation.
- Avoid unnecessary parallelism, repeated repository scans, duplicate reading, and verbose inter-agent messages.

## Constraints

- Follow the project's `CLAUDE.md`, security practices, and user instructions.
- Implement what the plan says and no more. Keep code simple and readable by humans; do not add abstractions or features the plan does not call for.
- Preserve existing user changes; check git status before edits. Do not commit, push, merge, delete, or deploy without authorization.
- Never infer that a test passed without observing its result. Preserve unknowns rather than fabricating evidence.
- If an agent has no delegation tool, say so and execute sequentially using the same file-based phase structure.

# Plan: `grill` mode for poe

## Objective
New mode `/poe:poe grill <task | plan-path>`: interview user in rounds (Matt Pocock's grill-with-docs method) until design tree resolved, then write same `plan.md` as plan mode. Maintains `poe/GLOSSARY.md` + `poe/docs/adr/` inline. `plan` mode unchanged.

Upstream (MIT, © 2026 Matt Pocock, github.com/mattpocock/skills); research in `poe/trash/poe-grill-with-docs/plan.md`:
- `grilling`: per round ask whole frontier (questions w/ settled prereqs); numbered, recommended answer each, "yes" = accept all; wait. Facts = agent looks up; decisions = user.
- `domain-modeling`: sharpen terms, edge-case scenarios, code cross-check; glossary written as each term resolves; ADR only if hard to reverse + surprising + real trade-off.
- Upstream gap: non-ADR decisions live only in chat → fix: all decisions → `plan.md` `## Decisions` each round.

## Grill vs plan
| | `plan` | `grill` |
|---|---|---|
| Turns | 1 + review | many rounds, then plan |
| Decides | agent assumes, user corrects | user decides, agent recommends |
| Fits | clear/small tasks | fuzzy scope, trade-offs, costly rework |
| Output | `plan.md` | + `## Decisions`, glossary, ADRs |
| Cost | fast | slower, more attention + context |
| Fails by | hidden assumptions | fatigue, trivia, bikeshedding |

## Decisions
- Separate `grill` mode; `plan` untouched.
- Method inline in bundled `skills/poe/GRILLING.md`; no upstream dependency.
- Shared docs at `poe/GLOSSARY.md` + `poe/docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md` (poe root, not task slug). Created lazily, shared across tasks.
- Slug `docs` reserved (collides w/ `poe/docs/`).
- Rounds as plain text, not AskUserQuestion (4-question cap).

## Scope
In:
- **New `skills/poe/GRILLING.md`**: credit + link + MIT notice. Rounds rules; facts via code/read-only subagents; recommendations obey "do not overengineer"; glossary format (term, 1–2 sentence def, `_Avoid_:` synonyms; project terms only; no impl detail); ADR 3 gates + format, number = highest + 1; skip trivia, small task may need 1 round.
- **`skills/poe/SKILL.md`**:
  - `argument-hint` + Operating modes: add `grill <task | plan-path>`; may write `poe/GLOSSARY.md`, `poe/docs/adr/`; no impl files.
  - Files: show `poe/GLOSSARY.md`, `poe/docs/adr/` beside task dirs; never use slug `docs`.
  - New Grill mode section:
    1. Plan step 1 + read `poe/GLOSSARY.md`, `poe/docs/adr/`, `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/GRILLING.md`.
    2. Arg = existing `plan.md` → load + grill only open/risky points. Else new slug, `plan.md` w/ only `## Decisions`.
    3. Each round: ask, stop. After answers: append `## Decisions`, write glossary/ADR now.
    4. Frontier empty → confirm shared understanding.
    5. On confirm → full plan per Plan steps 2–4 (keep Decisions, link ADRs), then Plan step 5 reply.
    6. Copy logs at end.
  - Split step 4: list `poe/GLOSSARY.md` / relevant ADRs in unit inputs when present.
- **`README.md`**: grill usage + 1–2 lines grill vs plan; Files tree adds shared docs; gitignore note: ignore `poe/*/logs/` + `poe/*/report.html`, not all of `poe/`, to keep glossary/ADRs; credit upstream.

Out:
- `plan` mode behavior, `phase-worker.md`, `poe_report.py`, tests, flags, glossary in report.

## Assumptions
- Keep uncommitted `less_verboosity` edits.
- Round questions terse; recommendation per question always kept.
- `poe/` relative to cwd (existing rule).

## Acceptance criteria
- `GRILLING.md` exists, credited w/ MIT notice, covers Scope items.
- SKILL.md: `grill` in argument-hint + modes; Grill section steps 1–6; reuses Plan steps by reference; Plan section unchanged; `docs` slug reserved.
- Split step 4 mentions glossary/ADR inputs.
- `claude plugin validate .` passes.
- `python3 -m unittest discover tests` passes.
- Manual: numbered rounds w/ recommendations; no full plan before confirm; facts not asked; `## Decisions` grows per round; `poe/GLOSSARY.md` written mid-session; ADRs only when gated (zero ok); ends w/ `Next:` block; `grill <plan.md>` after `/clear` doesn't re-ask settled points; nothing written outside `poe/`.

## Risks
- Fatigue / trivia → recommendations, "yes" accepts, skip-trivia rule.
- Docs written only at end (upstream bug) → explicit per-round write step.
- User ignores all of `poe/` in git → glossary/ADRs lost from history; README note.
- Upstream skills/tools expect root `GLOSSARY.md` → won't find poe's; accepted.
- Parent context grows over rounds → Decisions on disk; `/clear` + `grill <plan-path>`.
- Plan/grill drift → reference, don't copy.

## Validation
- `claude plugin validate .`
- `python3 -m unittest discover tests`
- Manual: scratch git repo; `claude --plugin-dir <this repo>`; `/poe:poe grill <fuzzy task, e.g. "add archiving for old notes">`; 2–3 rounds (mix "yes"/overrides); each round: `git status`, `cat poe/GLOSSARY.md`, `cat poe/<slug>/plan.md`. `/clear` → `/poe:poe grill poe/<slug>/plan.md` → no re-asks. `/poe:poe plan <same task>` → one-shot. `split` → briefs list `poe/GLOSSARY.md`.
